name: PPI Public Property Invest AB (publ)
summary: PPI Public Property Invest AB (publ) is a Nordic real estate company focused on owning, operating and developing social infrastructure properties with public-sector tenants. The company's portfolios comprise community service properties across the Nordic region, including elderly and healthcare facilities, schools and other social infrastructure assets. PPI Public Property Invest AB (publ) was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
